The '''Firestorm Turbolaser''' was an adaption of the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] developed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] for use in the [[Battle of Corellia]]. Consisting of an suspended ovoid with two [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] barrels attached, the weapon superheated its targets to literally set the air [[Fire/Legends|aflame]]. However, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] was able to destroy the three Firestorm Turbolasers that the Empire had deployed in [[Axial Park]], ending the threat.
